runs.text: Our students in Bachelor of Scienc
e in Computer Applications (BSCA) will undergo an In-plant training for 700 hours this coming second semester,
In lieu of this, we would like to request your good office to allow
BSCA students to have their SOJT program
under your guidance. We would be extremely grateful if you could accept them at your office.
Our IPT program aims for our students to achieve the following:
To know more of the "theory" component of their course in an "actual setting" so they may understand the nature of work in their chosen field of specialization.
To perform simulations and practical aids and allow them to rapidly and safely develop skills that are applicable to doing actual routine jobs together with your personnel.
To see a step-by-step demonstration of procedures that shows them the task being performed, as if they were doing the actual critical jobs.
To prove by actual assessments of the challenges in jobs related to their chosen field, especially when supported by supervised practical tests of skills carried out in the workplace.

runs.text: KNOW ALL MEN BY THESE PRESENTS:
MINDANAO STATE UNIVERSITY - ILIGAN INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY (hereinafter called MSU-IIT)
as an autonomous external unit of the Mindanao State University, with its principal office at Andres Bonifacio Avenue, Tibanga, Iligan City, Philippines represented by its College Dean
, duly authorized under SPECIAL ORDER No. 00959-IIT Series of 2025, hereinafter referred to as the FIRST PARTY; and
, hereinafter referred to as the SECOND PARTY;
WHEREAS, the FIRST PARTY has established a professional program for its students which was duly approved by the Commission on Higher Education ("CHED");
WHEREAS, one of the objectives of the program is to train students to become competitive, innovative, technical, and world-class
Bachelor of Science in Computer Applications (BSCA)
professionals through actual exposure to an Embedded / IoT or related workplace environment;
WHEREAS, the FIRST PARTY has chosen the SECOND PARTY as one of the former venues for practicum purposes given the latter's extensive resources and its proximity;
WHEREAS, the SECOND PARTY has agreed to cooperate with the FIRST PARTY in the utilization of the former's premises and facilities as an extension for educational training;
NOW THEREFORE, for and in consideration of the foregoing premises, the parties bind themselves to the following terms and conditions:

The FIRST PARTY will provide the SECOND PARTY with a list of names of participating students, the nature of each student’s educational assignments, the dates for reporting to their assigned tasks, and the total number of required training hours, which is 700 hours under the program.

The FIRST PARTY will designate a Supervised On-the-Job Coordinator (hereinafter referred to as Coordinator) who will coordinate with the SECOND PARTY regarding student assignments and training activities, assist in student evaluation, and resolve any disputes that may arise during training hours.
The FIRST PARTY, through the Coordinator, shall monitor the performance and professional demeanor of each student.

The FIRST PARTY undertakes to withdraw its endorsement for any student who, after due investigation into disciplinary infractions, proves to be unfit to continue practicum training. This action is taken to prevent personal harm or injury to fellow student-trainees, anyone employed with the SECOND PARTY, and/or potential property damage.
The FIRST PARTY agrees not to use the company name of the SECOND PARTY in any publication or advertising, except in school catalogs, bulletins, and student recruitment materials.
The SECOND PARTY agrees to train the following BSCA students:

Before the actual commencement of the practical training, the SECOND PARTY shall conduct an orientation lecture to apprise the participating students of the house rules and working regulations of the SECOND PARTY.
The SECOND PARTY agrees to conduct the training on-site, allowing them to learn and gain practical experience throughout the entire duration

The SECOND PARTY shall designate one or more members of its staff with appropriate qualifications to instruct and supervise the students during training hours, communicate with the Coordinator regarding the status of the training, and make said staff members available for academic consultation with the students.
The SECOND PARTY is primarily responsible for the actual supervision and control of practicum training and student activities while the OJT is still ongoing.
The SECOND PARTY may provide students with nominal financial or material consideration in the form of transportation and/or meal allowance.

The SECOND PARTY shall coordinate with the Coordinator regarding any concerns involving any of the students, particularly in matters of obedience to house rules and working regulations, and their educational process during training.
The SECOND PARTY agrees to schedule the dates of the practicum training to avoid conflicts with class schedules, if any, as provided by the FIRST PARTY.
The SECOND PARTY may absorb students after graduation if there are openings and if the students demonstrate the work qualities that the SECOND PARTY is looking for.
The SECOND PARTY agrees to provide each student in the Company with all company policies, rules, and regulations pertinent to the student's role in the practicum.
The SECOND PARTY shall issue to each student-trainee who satisfactorily completes the practicum training a Certificate of Completion.
